seo.title: HK DevLab — Web, AI & Software Solutions
seo.description: HK DevLab is a digital development studio that builds modern websites, web applications and custom digital experiences for startups, small businesses and growing brands.

hero.lede: A digital development studio building modern websites, web applications and custom digital experiences for startups and growing businesses.

lab.statement: HK DevLab turns ideas into *fast*, *responsive*, *user-friendly* products — with clean design and *reliable* development.

services.title: Websites
services.text: Fast, responsive sites that make a sharp first impression and turn visitors into customers.

services.title: Web Applications
services.text: Dashboards, portals and SaaS products designed around real users and built to scale.

services.title: AI Solutions
services.text: Assistants, automation and AI features that take repetitive work off your team's plate.

services.title: Custom Software
services.text: Tailored tools and integrations shaped around how your business actually runs.

principles.title: Fast
principles.text: Performance is a feature, not an afterthought.

principles.title: Responsive
principles.text: Flawless on every screen, from phone to widescreen.

principles.title: User-friendly
principles.text: Clear, intuitive interfaces people enjoy using.

principles.title: Reliable
principles.text: Clean, tested code you can depend on and build on.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: We learn your business, your customers and what success looks like — so every decision after this has a reason.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: From wireframes to polished UI. Clean, clear and on-brand, with your feedback built into every round.

steps.text: Modern, tested code. Fast pages, accessible interfaces and foundations that scale when you do.

steps.text: We deploy, test in the real world and hand over everything you need to run it with confidence.

steps.title: Grow
steps.text: Launch is the start. We keep improving with real data — new features, better performance, ongoing support.
